newsitem.title: USA: Norfolk Southern in Ford distribution pact.
newsitem.headline: Norfolk Southern in Ford distribution pact.

text.p: Norfolk Southern Corp said Monday that it has reached a long-term agreement to help Ford Motor Co cut the delivery time of new vehicles from its plants in North America.
Norfolk said about three million Ford vehicles will be distributed through the pact. The arrangement should cut transit time for vehicle distribution by as much as 33 percent, it said.
The agreement creates a network of mixing centers where vehicles brought by trains are sorted and coordinated with other railroads for final delivery.
The centers will be near Fostoria, Ohio, Chicago, Illinois, Shelbyville, Kentucky and Kansas City, Missouri, Norfolk said.
Norfolk said it expects to increase its motor vehicle business with Ford by about 60 percent once the network is fully operational in 1998.
